### E&F Currency Merge -- GENERATED FILE, DO NOT EDIT
### Rebuild with tools/regen_ef_currency_merge.py after any E&F or hotfix update.
###
### Country scope. Give the country a central bank company if it has none.
###
### ORDER MATTERS AND IT COST A ROUND TO FIND OUT. The slot has to be granted
### BEFORE add_company, not after. Finland owns a central bank and no company
### slots at all in 1836 -- add_company simply had nowhere to put the company,
### and the +1 arrived a line too late to help.
###
### There is nothing to choose between any more. The historical banks are
### E&F's to hand out and it has already done so by the time this runs; the
### generated one is a single type for everybody else. The ninety-five-branch
### chain that used to stand here is what overflowed the stack.

zz_ef_cm_grant_bank_company = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_modifier = zz_ef_cm_central_bank_charter } }
		add_modifier = zz_ef_cm_central_bank_charter
	}

	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { zz_ef_cm_has_bank_company = yes } }
		log = "ZZCM grant: [This.GetName] gets the generated central bank company"
		add_company = company_type:zz_ef_cm_central_bank
	}
}

### Keep the central bank company alive.
###
### This is the safety net, not the main road. The company that owns a central
### bank is chosen when the bank is built -- zz_ef_cm_create_owned_bank -- and
### this pass only catches a country that ended up with a central bank and no
### bank company at all.

zz_ef_cm_bank_company_upkeep = {
	### The denominator of this country's share of its market's currency demand:
	### the summed GDP of every central bank on the same market.
	###
	### It is computed HERE, in an effect, and read from the variable by
	### zz_ef_cm_issuer_share, because a global list iterator does not run inside
	### a script value. every_scope_state does, which is exactly why the first
	### version looked right: the same shape, one scope narrower, works. There
	### the sum silently stayed 0, min = 1 made it 1, and every country's share
	### came out clamped to the maximum of 1 -- so every bank on a market chased
	### the whole market's demand. The British market ran 1.22M of currency
	### against 214K of buy orders and the price sat at -98%.
	###
	### The scope is saved rather than compared with prev or root: inside
	### every_country, prev is the country being tested, and a saved scope is the
	### only unambiguous way back to the one being summed for.
	###
	### The membership test is "does a central bank stand here", not
	### has_modifier = has_central_bank. The modifier is E&F's bookkeeping and it
	### is applied and removed on its own pulses; a country whose bank is between
	### pulses would drop out of the denominator for a month, the remaining
	### issuers' shares would jump, and they would all overprint until it came
	### back. On a market with one issuer that is invisible -- its share is 1
	### either way -- which is exactly the shape of what is left: single-issuer
	### markets went quiet, Britain and France did not.
	save_scope_as = zz_ef_cm_share_country
	set_variable = { name = zz_ef_cm_market_weight  value = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			market = scope:zz_ef_cm_share_country.market
			zz_ef_cm_has_central_bank = yes
			NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_no_market_liquidity }
		}
		save_scope_as = zz_ef_cm_share_issuer
		scope:zz_ef_cm_share_country = {
			change_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_cm_market_weight
				add  = scope:zz_ef_cm_share_issuer.zz_ef_cm_issuer_weight
			}
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			zz_ef_cm_has_central_bank = yes
			NOT = { zz_ef_cm_has_bank_company = yes }
		}
		zz_ef_cm_grant_bank_company = yes
	}

	### The slot, for a country whose company arrived with the bank.
	if = {
		limit = {
			zz_ef_cm_has_central_bank = yes
			NOT = { has_modifier = zz_ef_cm_central_bank_charter }
		}
		add_modifier = zz_ef_cm_central_bank_charter
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_modifier = zz_ef_cm_central_bank_charter
			NOT = { zz_ef_cm_has_central_bank = yes }
		}
		remove_modifier = zz_ef_cm_central_bank_charter
	}

	### The historical bank has turned up while the stand-in holds the central
	### bank. Ownership cannot be moved -- add_ownership exists only inside
	### create_building -- so the only way to hand it over is to build it again.
	###
	### THE REBUILD IS CALLED FROM HERE, not merely asked for. The old version set
	### zz_ef_cm_bank_rebuild and waited for E&F to call a spawner again, which is
	### why Austria and Spain sat on their stand-in for the rest of the campaign:
	### E&F calls macro_facilities_bc when gdp_view crosses a threshold, not on a
	### schedule, so for a country whose economy is not growing that call never
	### comes. The variable still goes up, because it is what makes the dispatcher
	### stop skipping a bank that is already the right size.
	###
	### THE SIZE IS A LITERAL, one branch per level, and that is not verbosity.
	### $CB_SIZE$ is a macro argument -- pasted in as text, and it lands inside
	### `add_ownership = { company = { levels = $CB_SIZE$ } }`, where a `var:` read
	### does not resolve. Passing one there cost four countries their central bank
	### outright: the dispatcher removed the building, created it with zero levels,
	### and logged nothing at all -- Persia, Turkey, Sicily and Spain simply had no
	### bank any more. Every one of E&F's own 1,004 call sites passes a literal.
	###
	### Only one branch can match: they test the level for equality, and a rebuild
	### puts back exactly what it took away.
	if = {
		limit = {
			zz_ef_cm_has_central_bank = yes
			zz_ef_cm_holds_own_historical_bank = yes
			zz_ef_cm_holds_stand_in_bank = yes
		}
		set_variable = zz_ef_cm_bank_rebuild
		random_scope_state = {
			limit = { has_building = building_bank }
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_scope_building = {
						is_building_type = building_bank
						level = 1
					}
				}
				zz_ef_cm_create_owned_bank = { BANK_BLDG_TYPE = building_bank CB_SIZE = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_scope_building = {
						is_building_type = building_bank
						level = 2
					}
				}
				zz_ef_cm_create_owned_bank = { BANK_BLDG_TYPE = building_bank CB_SIZE = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_scope_building = {

					}
				}
				zz_ef_cm_create_owned_bank = { BANK_BLDG_TYPE = building_bank CB_SIZE = 3 }
			}

					}

						is_building_type = building_bank
						level = 100
					}
				}
				zz_ef_cm_create_owned_bank = { BANK_BLDG_TYPE = building_bank CB_SIZE = 100 }
			}
		}
	}

	### ...and once it has, the stand-in owns nothing and has no reason to exist.
	### Retired only after the rebuild cleared the variable, so the country is
	### never left with a central bank and nobody holding it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			zz_ef_cm_holds_own_historical_bank = yes
			zz_ef_cm_holds_stand_in_bank = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = zz_ef_cm_bank_rebuild }
		}
		zz_ef_cm_retire_stand_in_bank = yes
	}

	### And the monopoly on central banks goes to whoever holds it.
	if = {
		limit = { zz_ef_cm_has_central_bank = yes }
		zz_ef_cm_bank_monopoly = yes
	}
}

### Drop the generated stand-in once the country's own historical bank has
### taken the central bank over. One line now: there is one stand-in type.

zz_ef_cm_retire_stand_in_bank = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_company = company_type:zz_ef_cm_central_bank }
		log = "ZZCM retire: [This.GetName] drops the generated stand-in"
		remove_company = company_type:zz_ef_cm_central_bank
	}
}
